purpose.zh: 练肩胛前伸，把地面推远
purpose.en: Train shoulder blade protraction by pushing the floor away.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，胸口下沉再把地面推远
text.en: Keep your arms straight, let your chest sink, then push the floor away

text.zh: 高位平板，身体一条直线
text.en: Hold a high plank with your body in one line.

text.zh: 顶端把背推圆，肩胛向前包住胸廓
text.en: At the top, round your upper back and wrap your shoulder blades forward.

commonErrors.en: Bending the elbows into a push-up.
Sagging the hips instead of moving the shoulder blades.

cautions.zh: 先做2–3分钟手腕热身；腕部刺痛或麻木立即停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists for 2–3 minutes first; stop right away if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
